features: prominent short triangular bony horn crests above the eyes
large, bright, intelligent eyes with a calm expression
cleanly closed mouth showing a gentle neutral demeanor

layer_3_action.action: A calm, approachable Albertosaurus with clean, high-poly clay features is stepping gracefully across a mudstone plain, its body held in a sleek horizontal pose. The camera captures it in a balanced three-quarter profile, focusing on its distinctive triangular eyebrow horns and strong legs without any over-rounded toddler toy elements. It looks down with a curious demeanor at a small patch of floating Azolla ferns, framed by quiet Metasequoia trees under soft, cinematic studio lighting. No text.
